exclude.why: wrong key: 'self-enforcing system' but standard fact is that VAT is self-enforcing (invoice-credit trail); the description that does not fit VAT is 'it will diminish revenue buoyancy'
wrong key: 2003 but standard fact is that uniform floor rates of sales tax took effect from 1 January 2000 (2003 is Haryana's VAT, from 1 April)
wrong key: 3,1,2,4 (customs largest) but customs was never the largest Central tax then; standard order c.2009 is corporation > income > excise > customs = 1,2,4,3
